Paramaribo, SURINAME 87032291 1037490" and "2026-02-24 ... Colombo, Sri Lanka 87032191 9976490". domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split found in the sources reachable within the tool budget. The only domestic-side signal is the registered address on the customs record ("E 802, SAFAL PARISAR-1, SOUTH BOPAL", i.e. Ahmedabad, Gujarat), which is an address, not a supply record. Domestic supply evidence: null.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records from Ahmedabad ICD to Suriname, Sri Lanka and South Africa, with HS 8703.22/8703.21/8703.33 — consistent with the declared HS 870333 (8703.33 = vehicles >1500cc-3000cc petrol, matching the 87033391 line to Durban). Note the declared 6-digit code 870333 is one of several codes actually shipped (87032291, 87032191, 87033391, plus one 87113020 motorcycle line), so the declared HS is a subset, not an error. IMPORTANT disambiguation: the similarly named "HORIZON ENTERPRISES" (Moradabad, handicrafts/housewares, HS 7326/7616/8215, buyers Cape Union Mart, Urban Outfitters) is a DIFFERENT legal entity and was excluded from this assessment. Caveat on the counter: ImportKey reports 501 total shipments but the free view exposes only 5 rows, so the 501 figure is a platform counter, not independently verified row-by-row. Volza, Eximpedia and Trademo returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused), so no second independent source could be cross-checked; the export finding rests on a single source. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null (not public in the free view). No GSTIN/PAN/CIN found in reachable sources — left null rather than guessed. Role appears to be trader/exporter of vehicles (buyer field reads "TO ORDER"/"TO THE ORDER OF AMANA BANK PLC" under LC), not a manufacturer.
